拍单收货手册Snap Invoice: staff guide for goods receiving

拍下供应商的单据，AI 大约 15 秒把商品、数量、金额列出来，你不用再一个一个找商品、打数字。
Photograph the supplier's paper and the AI lists the items, quantities and amounts in about 15 seconds, so you no longer search and type every item.

最重要的一条：AI 只是帮你填，数量要你自己数，金额要你对着纸看。每一行和总额都要你按确认，App 会记下是谁确认的。
The one rule: the AI only fills in. You count the quantity yourself and check the amount against the paper. You confirm every line and the total, and the App records who confirmed.

哪些分店可以用Which stores

BR01BR19BR13BR25BR20BR24 ☕BR26 ☕
收货、退货、报废都是这几间先用；其他分店开放后会另外通知。首页没有「收货」按钮，就是你的店还没开放。 · Receiving, returns and disposals start in these stores; other stores will be told when they are added. No Goods receive button on the home screen means your store is not on yet.

拍照规矩How to photograph the paper

✓ 要这样 Do

  • 只拍供应商的单据（发票或送货单）
    Only the supplier's paper (invoice or delivery order)
  • 整张放平，四个角都要拍到
    Flat, all four corners in the photo
  • 光线够，字看得清楚
    Good light, the print is sharp
  • 单据有两页，用「再拍一张（背面 / 第二页）」
    A second page goes in One more photo (back / page 2)
  • 拍照后 App 重开、照片不见？先用手机相机拍，再按「从相册选」
    Photo lost when the App reopened? Take it with the phone camera, then tap From gallery

✗ 不要 Don't

  • 拍货架、货物、收银机的单
    Shelves, goods, or our own POS receipt
  • 单据折起来、手指挡住数字
    Folded paper, fingers over the numbers
  • 太斜、太暗、有反光
    Steep angle, too dark, glare
  • 一张照片拍两张不同的单
    Two different papers in one photo
① 拍单收货 · Snap invoice

一步一步做Step by step

截图是 BR25（不在盲收试行）。BR19、BR01 请同时看 ①b。 · The screens are from BR25 (not in the blind trial). BR19 and BR01: also read ①b.

  1. 首页「货与设备」按 收货，再按 选供应商。负责几间店的人，先在最上面点对的店号。
    On the home screen, under Goods & machines, tap Goods receive, then Pick supplier. If you cover more than one store, tap the right store code at the top first.
首页 · Home

第 1 步（续）：点你的供应商。名单来自 AutoCount，只列出你这间店公司的供应商。找不到就打至少 3 个字，按「用我打的名字」。能从名单选就从名单选，打的名字账务要手动对。
Step 1 (cont.): tap your supplier. The list comes from AutoCount and only shows your company's suppliers. Not there? Type at least 3 letters and tap Use the name I typed. Pick from the list whenever you can; a typed name has to be matched by hand in accounting.

选供应商 · Pick supplier
  1. 拍单据。按 📷 拍照，照上面的拍照规矩拍整张。没有照片不能送出。
    Photograph the paper. Tap 📷 Take photo and follow the photo rules above. A receipt cannot be sent without the photo.
2. 拍单据 · Photo
  1. 看单据类型和单号。新的一张默认是 发票 Invoice；单上没有价钱才改成 送货单 DO。单号照单上抄（AI 读完也会帮你填，要对一下）。「单上总额」可以留空，AI 会读。当场从收银机拿现金付给送货员才填「当场付现」，没有就留空。短交、拒收、破损可以在「备注」写一句。
    Check the paper type and number. A new receipt starts as Invoice; switch to Delivery order (DO) only if the paper shows no prices. Copy the document no. from the paper (the AI fills it too; check it). Total on the paper can stay blank; the AI reads it. Fill Cash paid to the driver only if cash from the till was paid to the driver right then; otherwise leave it blank. Use Note for one line on anything short, refused or damaged.
  2. 在「3. 点数」按 📷 AI 读单，自动列出商品。等大约 15 秒，这段时间可以先开始点货。
    Under 3. Count, tap Read the paper with AI. Wait about 15 seconds; you can start counting meanwhile.
单据资料 · Paper details
  1. 每一行都要点开核对。AI 读到的每一行都是「待核对」。点开一行：看商品对不对，自己数实际收到几个，对着纸看金额，然后按 ✓ 数量和金额都对，确认。没送到的那一行，按「这行没收到」。写着「没对上我们的商品，请选」的，点开按「选商品」自己选。
    Open and check every line. Each line the AI read starts as To check. Open it: check the product, count what actually arrived, check the amount against the paper, then tap Quantity and amount are right, confirm. For a line that did not arrive, tap This line was not received. A line saying Not matched to our product: open it and tap Choose product.
AI 读到 5 项 · AI read 5 lines

第 5 步（续）：核对一行的画面。上面是单据上印的，下面是我们的商品。「实际收到」要你自己数了再改；数量比单据少，App 自动记成短少。写着「按名字配对，请看清楚」最容易错，看清楚包装再确认；不对就按「换商品」。
Step 5 (cont.): the line check screen. The top shows what the paper says, below is our product. Count and correct Actually received yourself; fewer than the paper is recorded as short. Matched by name; check it is where mistakes happen: check the pack before confirming, or tap Change product.

示范资料：F&N BEVERAGES (DEMO) 的发票 IV-88213，第 3 行。
Demo data: F&N BEVERAGES (DEMO) invoice IV-88213, line 3.

核对一行 · Check a line
  1. 纸上没有、但有送来的货，按 ＋ 加货品 手动加（见 ①a）。
    Goods that arrived but are not on the paper: add them by hand with Add item (see ①a).
  2. 确认单据总额。对着纸上的总额，一样就按「总额和纸上一样，确认」，按完会变成 ✓ 总额已确认。
    Confirm the paper total. If it matches the paper, tap Total matches the paper, confirm; it then shows Total confirmed.
  3. 按 送出收货 (项数)，再确认。送出后不能再改。还有「待核对」的行，或总额还没确认，App 不会让你送出。
    Tap Send goods receive (items) and confirm. It cannot be changed after sending. The App will not send while a line is To check or the total is not confirmed.
送出 · Send

看懂标签What the labels mean

待核对还没点开核对，一定要处理。 · To check: not checked yet; it must be done.
✓ 已确认你已经数过、对过金额。 · Confirmed: you counted it and checked the amount.
没收到这一行的货没有送来。 · Not received: this line did not arrive.
按名字配对，请看清楚AI 按商品名字猜是我们哪个货，最容易错，看清楚包装再确认。 · Matched by name: the AI guessed from the name. This is where mistakes happen; check the pack before confirming.
⚠ 没对上我们的商品，请选找不到是我们哪个货，按「选商品」自己选。 · Not matched: tap Choose product and pick it yourself.
以前确认过的配对同事以前确认过这个配对，比较可靠，但数量照样要数。 · Matched as confirmed before: a colleague confirmed this match earlier. More reliable, but still count it.

遇到这些情况When this happens

实际收到比单据少 · Fewer arrived than the paper says
填你数到的数字。App 会自动把差的数量记成「短少」。金额照纸上的填，HQ 会跟供应商处理。
Enter what you counted. The App records the difference as short. Enter the amount as printed; HQ follows up with the supplier.
单据写「箱」，我们算「个」 · The paper says cartons, we count pieces
App 会提醒你。拆开数实际有几个，用我们的单位填。下次同一个供应商，AI 会记得一箱几个。
The App warns you. Count the pieces and enter them in our unit. Next time the AI remembers how many are in a carton for this supplier.
司机在单据上手写改了数字 · The driver changed a number by hand
数量填你实际数到的。金额填改过之后的，并在「备注」写一句，例如「司机把 10 改成 8」。
Enter the quantity you counted. Enter the corrected amount and add a note, e.g. "driver changed 10 to 8".
AI 读错、读不到，或等超过 3 分钟 · The AI misread, failed, or took over 3 minutes
读错的行直接在核对画面改。读不到就重拍清楚一点，按「重新读」；每张单最多读 3 次。等太久就照平常手动加商品，然后送出。
Fix a misread line on its check screen. If it failed, retake a clearer photo and tap Read again (at most 3 reads per paper). If it takes too long, add the items by hand as before and send.
AI 读到的单号和我打的不一样 · The AI's document number differs from mine
以纸上印的为准，改成对的那一个。
The printed number wins; correct whichever one is wrong.
要放弃一张单 · Discarding a receipt
按最下面的「放弃这张」。只有开单的人或经理能放弃，放弃前会显示是谁开的、已有几项。
Tap Discard this one at the bottom. Only the person who started it, or a manager, can discard it; the App first shows who started it and how many items it has.
确认错了一行 · I confirmed a line by mistake
送出之前，重新点那一行再改，或在下面的商品清单按 ✕ 删除，那一行会回到「待核对」。
Before sending, open the line again and change it, or tap ✕ on it in the item list below; it goes back to To check.
送出后才发现错 · A mistake found after sending
店里改不了。告诉 HQ 账务：供应商、单号、错在哪里。
The store cannot change it. Tell HQ accounting the supplier, document number and what is wrong.

两家供应商同时到Two suppliers arrive together

每个收银员收自己那一家。上方「这间店正在收的货」会列出所有进行中的单，标着 我正在做 的就是你的。要收另一家，按「另一家供应商也到了：开始另一张收货」。别人的单（点开接手）不要动，除非要接手，例如换班。
Each cashier receives their own supplier. Deliveries being received in this store lists every open receipt; the one marked Mine now is yours. For another supplier, tap Another supplier arrived: start another receipt. Leave a colleague's receipt (Open to take over) alone unless you are taking it over, e.g. at a shift change.

两张单 · Two receipts
①a 手动加货 · Adding items by hand

纸上没有的货、AI 读不到的时候Items not on the paper, or when the AI can't read it

  1. 按 ＋ 加货品。先看到的是这个供应商的货品（「本供应商」）。不在里面就打名字、货号或条码数字，其他供应商的货也会出现，一样可以选；也可以按「全部货品」。每个货品下面有 ▮▯▮ 条码，和包装上的对一下再选。
    Tap Add item. It opens on this supplier's items (This supplier). Not there? Type the name, code or barcode digits; items from other suppliers appear too and can be picked; or tap All items. Each item shows its ▮▯▮ barcode; check it against the pack before picking.
整个系统都找不到，才按最下面的「找不到？新增货品」：照包装写名字，有条码一定要填，单上有进货价就填，再按「建立并填数量」。这个货会标 待开码，送出后这张单可能显示 账务待处理，等 HQ 在 AutoCount 开货号。这是正常的，店里不用再做什么。系统已有同样的货，App 会帮你选上原本那个。
Only when it is nowhere in the system, tap Can't find it? Add a new item at the bottom: name as printed on the pack, the barcode whenever there is one, the cost price if it is on the paper, then Create and enter quantity. The item shows Code pending, and after sending the receipt may show Accounting to check until HQ creates the AutoCount code. That is normal; the store has nothing more to do. If the item already exists, the App picks the existing one.
加货品 · Add item
  1. 填数量。「实收」= 真正送到店里的。「短交」= 单上有、没送到的。「破损」= 送到但不能卖的。过期或退回的货交给这个司机带走，填「退货（交回司机）」。包装上有到期日就填。
    Enter the numbers. Received = what actually arrived. Short = on the paper but not delivered. Damaged = delivered but unsellable. Expired or returned stock handed to this driver goes in Returned to driver. Fill the expiry date if the pack shows one.

    例子：单上 24 瓶，到 22 瓶 → 实收 22、短交 2、破损 0。
    Example: paper 24, arrived 22 → Received 22, Short 2, Damaged 0.

  2. 按 保存。数错了点那一行重填；加错了按那一行右边的 ✕。
    Tap Save. Wrong number: tap the line and fix it. Wrong item: tap ✕ on that line.
写着「必填（短保质期货品）」的货，一定要填到期日，不然不能送出。
An item marked "required (short-life item)" must have its expiry date, or the receipt cannot be sent.
3. 点数 · Count

送出之后看状态After sending: the status

「以往的收货」列出最近的单，每张有一个状态： · Earlier deliveries lists recent receipts, each with a status:

传送中账务正在处理，不用做什么。 · Sending: accounting is processing it. Nothing to do.
已入 AutoCount + GRN 号完成，AutoCount 已有这张 GRN。 · In AutoCount: done; the GRN is in AutoCount.
账务待处理账务发现问题（例如新货待开码），会联系店里。点开可看原因。 · Accounting to check: accounting found something (e.g. a new item waiting for its code) and will contact the store. Open it to see why.
①b 盲收试行 · BR19, BR01

BR19、BR01：先数，再看单据BR19, BR01: count first, then see the paper (blind receiving trial)

这两间店试行两星期。AI 读完单后，还没核对的行先不显示单据的数量和金额（写着「先数，数完才显示单据数量」），你数完才看得到。
These two stores trial this for two weeks. After the AI reads the paper, a line not yet checked hides the paper's quantity and amount (it says count first; the paper qty shows after) until you have counted.

  1. 点开一行，看商品对不对（不对就「换商品」）。
    Open a line and check the product (tap Change product if wrong).
  2. 自己数实际收到几个，填在「实际收到（自己数）」。没收到就填 0。
    Count what actually arrived and type it in Actually received. Nothing arrived? Type 0.
  3. 按 数好了，看单据。
    Tap Counted, show the paper.
核对第 2 行 · BR19
  1. 单据的数量和金额出现：一样会显示绿色「和单据一样」；不一样会显示红色，请再数一次。数量以你数的为准，不要改成单据的数字。然后对金额、按「数量和金额都对，确认」。没收到的那一行，填 0 看单据后按「这行没收到」。
    The paper's quantity and amount appear: green Same as the paper, or red if different; count again. Your count is what goes in; don't change it to the paper's number. Then check the amount and tap Quantity and amount are right, confirm. For a line that did not arrive, enter 0, show the paper, then tap This line was not received.

App 会记下你第一次数的数字，用来看试行有没有抓到更多少送。
The App keeps your first count to see whether the trial catches more short deliveries.

数完看单据 · After counting
为什么要自己数？收货就是核对"供应商说送了多少"和"我们真的收到多少"。如果只照 AI 读的按确认，少送、送错、过期货都查不出来，公司就会照单付钱。你按下确认，就是你签名负责。
Why count it yourself? Receiving compares what the supplier says it delivered with what we actually got. If you only confirm what the AI read, short deliveries, wrong items and expired stock go unnoticed, and the company pays the paper anyway. Tapping confirm is your signature.
退货 / 报废 · Return / Disposal

货品离开门市，不是卖出去的Stock leaving the store other than by a sale

首页按 「退货 / 报废」。上面两个分页：↩ 退货给供应商、🗑 报废。App 只做记录，HQ 会在 AutoCount 扣库存、跟供应商算账。
On the home screen tap Return / Disposal. Two tabs at the top: ↩ Return to supplier and 🗑 Disposal. The App records it; HQ takes the stock off in AutoCount and settles with the supplier.

↩ 退货给供应商 Return

货交回供应商或司机带走：过期、破损、送错、多送、空箱／空桶退押金。送出就完成。
Goods go back to the supplier: expired, damaged, wrong item, excess, empty crates / kegs for the deposit. Done when sent.

🗑 报废 Disposal

货要丢掉：过期、破损、变质、虫鼠咬。要店长或 HQ 批准，自己不能批自己的。
Goods are thrown away: expired, damaged, spoilt, pest damage. The store manager or HQ must approve; nobody approves their own.
司机送货时顺便带走过期货？那不是这里，是在那一张收货单的商品里填「退货（交回司机）」（见 ①a）。这个页面是给单独退货用的：退空箱、司机另外来收、没有新货一起送。
Driver takes expired stock back while delivering? That is not here: enter it as Returned to driver on that delivery's goods receive (see ①a). This page is for returns on their own: empties, a separate pick-up, no new goods delivered with it.

② 退货给供应商Return to supplier

  1. 「退货 / 报废」→ ↩ 退货给供应商 → 选供应商。找不到就打名字，按「用我打的名字」。
    Return / Disposal → ↩ Return to supplier → pick the supplier. Not in the list? Type the name and tap Use the name I typed.
  2. 拍供应商的退货单（Return Note / Empties Return），司机签过名的那张，整张入镜。没有单就拍交回的货。一定要有照片才能送出。
    Photograph the supplier's return note (Return Note / Empties Return), the one the driver signed, whole page in frame. No note? Photograph the goods handed back. A photo is required to send.
  3. 填退货单号（照单上抄）、原发票号（知道才填），再选供应商怎么处理：开贷项单／换新货／退现金／退押金（空箱/空桶）。
    Enter the return note no. (copy it from the paper) and the original invoice no. (only if known), then pick What the supplier does: credit note / replacement / cash refund / deposit refund (empties).
退货给供应商 · BR19
  1. 加货品：按「加货品」，搜名字、货号或条码。空箱在「全部货品」搜 empty，例如 EMPTY CRATE、EMPTY KEG。填数量，选原因：过期／破损／送错货／多送 / 卖不完／空箱 / 空桶／厂家回收／其他，再按「保存」。
    Add item: tap Add item and search name, code or barcode. For empties search empty under All items, e.g. EMPTY CRATE, EMPTY KEG. Enter the qty, pick the reason: expired / damaged / wrong item / excess or unsold / empty crates or kegs / recall / other, then tap Save.

例子：BR19 退 6 个空箱给 HONG BEE DISTRIBUTORS (DEMO)，退货单 22184。
Example: BR19 returning 6 empty crates to HONG BEE DISTRIBUTORS (DEMO), return note 22184.

选原因 · Pick the reason
  1. 按 送出退货 (1)。括号里是几样货。送出后不能再改。HQ 会收到任务，在 AutoCount 做退货或等供应商的贷项单。
    Tap Send return (1). The number is how many items. It cannot be changed after sending. HQ gets a task and posts the return in AutoCount, or waits for the supplier's credit note.
送出退货 · Send return

③ 报废Disposal

  1. 先记录，再丢。「退货 / 报废」→ 🗑 报废。
    Record first, then throw away. Return / Disposal → 🗑 Disposal.
  2. 拍要丢的货。排好一起拍，数量、到期日或破损的地方要看得到。按钮写着「拍照（必须）」，没照片不能送出。
    Photograph the goods. Lay them out together; the quantity and the expiry date or damage must show. The button says Take photo (required); it cannot be sent without one.
  3. 加货品、数量、原因：过期／破损／变质 / 坏掉／虫鼠咬／其他。包装上有到期日就填，可以写备注。App 会显示大约的成本。
    Add each item, qty and reason: expired / damaged / spoilt / pest damage / other. Enter the expiry date if printed, and a note if useful. The App shows the approximate cost.
  4. 按 送出等批准。状态变成 等批准。
    Tap Send for approval. The status becomes To approve.
报废 · BR19
  1. 店长 / HQ 批准。店长首页的「退货 / 报废」按钮会显示有几张在等，打开后最上面是「等批准的报废」。点开看照片和货品，按 批准报废；不对就在「备注（退回必填）」写原因，按「退回」。批准后 HQ 在 AutoCount 做库存调整。
    The manager / HQ approves. The manager's Return / Disposal button shows how many are waiting; Disposals to approve is at the top. Open one, check the photo and items, tap Approve disposal; if something is wrong, write the reason in Note (required to reject) and tap Reject. After approval HQ adjusts the stock in AutoCount.
店长批准 · Manager approves

看懂状态What the status means

草稿还没送出，可以改、可以放弃。 · Draft: not sent yet; can be changed or discarded.
已送出退货已完成，交给 HQ。 · Sent: the return is done and with HQ.
等批准报废在等店长或 HQ。 · To approve: the disposal is waiting for the manager or HQ.
已批准可以丢了，HQ 会扣库存。 · Approved: throw it away; HQ takes the stock off.
已退回没批准。点开看原因，要的话改好重新开一张。 · Rejected: not approved. Open it for the reason; if needed, start a new one correctly.

退货 / 报废：遇到这些情况Return / disposal: when this happens

店长自己要报废 · The manager is the one disposing
照样送出，由另一位店长或 HQ 批准。自己的单不会出现批准按钮。
Send it as usual; another manager or HQ approves. Your own disposal has no approve button.
还没批准，货可以先丢吗？ · Can I throw it away before approval?
先放一边、标好「待报废」，批准后再丢。已经坏掉会发臭的，拍清楚照片后可以先处理，在备注写明。
Keep it aside marked "to dispose" and throw it away after approval. Anything already rotting may go once clearly photographed; say so in the note.
司机没给退货单 · The driver gave no return note
拍交回的货（看得到数量），退货单号留空，备注写司机名字或车牌。
Photograph the goods handed back (qty visible), leave the note no. empty, and write the driver's name or lorry plate in the note.
找不到那个货品 · The item is not in the list
先切到「全部货品」再搜。还是没有就选最接近的，在那一行的备注写真正的名字，HQ 会处理。
Switch to All items and search again. Still missing? Pick the closest one and write the real name in that line's note; HQ sorts it out.
填错了 · I entered something wrong
送出前：点那一行改，或按 ✕ 删掉。送出后不能改，请告诉 HQ。只有开单的人或经理能「放弃这张」。
Before sending: tap the line to change it, or ✕ to delete it. After sending it cannot be changed; tell HQ. Only the person who started it, or a manager, can Discard this one.
④ 网购 · Online orders

网购包裹（Shopee、拼多多）Online parcels (Shopee, Pinduoduo)

网购包裹只有面单，没有发票或送货单。所以分两半做：HQ 付款后登记订单，门市收到包裹时对上订单、数货，两边用面单上的号码连起来。
An online parcel has only a label, no invoice or DO. So it is done in two halves: HQ records the order after paying, and the store matches the parcel to it and counts; the number on the label links the two.

HQ：付款后马上登记HQ: record it right after paying

  1. 收货 → 所有门市 → 🛒 网购订单 → 登记网购订单。列表分「运送中 / 已收到 / 全部」；超过 14 天还在运送中的会标红「逾期」。
    Goods receive → All stores → 🛒 Online orders → Record an online order. The list has On the way / Received / All; orders still on the way after 14 days show a red days late.
网购订单 · HQ (DEMO)
  1. 填：平台、送到哪间店、订单号、付款的卡（MBB 或 RHB）、付款日期、实付总额（含运费），拍或选平台收据截图。拼多多走集运：集运单号出来后再回来补「运单号」。
    Fill in: platform, store it ships to, order no., card (MBB or RHB), date paid, total paid (incl. shipping), and the platform receipt screenshot. Pinduoduo ships consolidated: come back and add the waybill no. once it is known.
登记订单 · Record order
  1. 每一样货都要列出来（「加一样货」），选卖的（入库存）或门市自用。卖的要按「选我们的货品」；自用的写名字就好。最后按「保存」。
    List every item (Add an item) and choose For sale (stock) or Store use. For sale needs Pick our item; store use just needs the name. Then tap Save.
  2. 退款或没寄出，打开那张订单按「取消这张订单」。
    Refunded or never shipped: open the order and tap Cancel this order.
买了什么 · Items

门市：收到包裹Store: the parcel arrives

  1. 收货 → 选供应商 SHOPEE CASH 或 PINDUODUO。App 自动变成「🛒 网购包裹」，不用填金额。
    Goods receive → supplier SHOPEE CASH or PINDUODUO. It switches to 🛒 Online parcel by itself; no amounts to fill in.
  2. 拍包裹面单，再把面单上的订单号（拼多多是集运单号）填在「面单上的订单号」。
    Photograph the parcel label, then type the label's order no. (Pinduoduo: the consolidation waybill no.) into Order no. on the label.
  3. 在「号码对得上的订单」按 对上。对不上就打开「其他运送中的订单」找。
    Under Orders with this number, tap Match. Nothing there? Look under Other orders on the way.
对上订单 · Match
  1. 拆开数货。卖的货按「点数」填实际收到几个；自用的货在右边格子填收到几个（没收到填 0）。
    Open it and count. For-sale items: tap Count and enter what arrived. Store-use items: type the received qty in the box on the right (0 if missing).
  2. 送出收货。卖的货进库存，自用的不进；HQ 会收到任务，把采购、费用和那张卡的扣款对上。
    Send. For-sale items go into stock, store-use items do not; HQ gets a task to post the purchase and expense and match the card charge.
数货 · Count
HQ 还没登记这张订单 · HQ has not recorded the order
照样拍面单、数货、送出。系统会标红通知 HQ 去补。货放一边，等 HQ 确认是卖的还是自用。
Photo the label, count and send anyway. HQ is flagged to add it. Keep the goods aside until HQ says whether they are for sale or store use.
面单号码和订单对不上 · The label number doesn't match the order
以面单为准。不同的订单号就是不同的订单，不要硬对。
The label wins. A different order no. is a different order; don't force a match.
⑤ 要货 · Stock request

建议订货量Suggested order quantities

向 HQ 要货时，App 按过去 4 个星期同一天卖了多少帮你算要订几个。你只要数货架，数字就出来了。
When you ask HQ for stock, the App works out how many to order from what sold on the same weekdays over the last 4 weeks. You just count the shelf and the number appears.

一定要自己数货架（连后仓）。系统里的库存常常不准，所以 App 不拿它来算，只给你参考。没数货架，那样货就不能加。
Always count the shelf yourself (including the back store). The system stock is often wrong, so the App does not use it in the sum; it is shown for reference only. An item can't be added until its shelf is counted.

怎么算How the number is worked out

建议 = 接下来几天的预计销量 + 1 天安全量 − 上星期报废 − 已经要了还没到的 − 货架上的
Suggested = expected sales for the next few days + 1 day of safety − last week's disposals − already asked for but not arrived − what is on the shelf
预计销量按星期几算：星期六卖得多，就多算星期六。结果进位成整数，不会是负数。 · Expected sales go by weekday: if Saturdays sell more, Saturday counts more. The result is rounded up and never below 0.
  1. 「要货申请」→ 📊 建议订货量。
    Stock request → 📊 Suggested order.
  2. 选这张单要够卖几天：3、5、7、10 或 14 天。一般用 7 天（HQ 可以改默认）。
    Pick how many days this order should cover: 3, 5, 7, 10 or 14. Usually 7 (HQ can change the default).
  3. 从上往下数货架。卖得最快的排在最前面，先显示 50 样，要更多按「显示更多」。在「货架」填你数到的数量，马上出现建议，「订」也自动填好。还没数的写着「先数货架」。
    Count the shelf from the top down. Fastest sellers come first; 50 are shown, tap Show more for the rest. Type what you counted in Shelf; the Suggested number appears and Order is filled in. Items not counted yet say Count the shelf first.

    例子：矿泉水每天平均卖 6.1 瓶。算 7 天 + 1 天安全量 ≈ 49 瓶，货架有 20 瓶，所以建议 29 瓶。
    Example: mineral water sells 6.1 a day. 7 days + 1 safety day ≈ 49; 20 on the shelf, so 29 suggested.

  4. 要改数量可以改。改得比建议多或少超过 30%（而且差 2 个以上），下面会出现下拉选单「改动较大，选原因」：促销、活动 / 节日、天气、货架位置不够、其他（其他要写一句）。
    You can change the quantity. If it is more than 30% above or below the suggestion (and at least 2 different), a drop-down Big change: pick a reason appears: promotion, event / festival, weather, not enough shelf space, other (other needs a line of text).

    例子：下星期有球赛，TIGER 建议 24 罐，订 48 罐，选「活动 / 节日」。
    Example: a football match next week; TIGER suggested 24, ordered 48, reason Event / festival.

  5. 拉到最下面按 加进要货单。有数货架、订的数量大于 0 的才会加进去。之后照平常在「要货申请」检查、按送出。
    Scroll to the bottom and tap Add to the request. Only items with a shelf count and an order above 0 are added. Then check and send the request as usual.
建议订货量 · BR19

看懂画面上的字What the screen shows

日均过去 28 天每天平均卖几个。 · Avg/day: average sold per day over the last 28 days.
有卖的天28 天里有几天卖出。数字小就是慢货，少订。 · Days sold: on how many of the 28 days it sold. A low number means a slow seller; order less.
已要未到还在等 HQ 的要货，或 3 天内批准的，已经扣掉了。 · Asked, not in: requests still with HQ, or approved in the last 3 days. Already taken off.
上周报废上星期丢掉的，已经从预计销量扣掉，免得一直订太多。 · Disposed last wk: already taken off the expected sales so we stop over-ordering.
系统库存AutoCount 的数字，只在看起来可信时才显示，只作参考。 · System stock: the AutoCount figure, shown only when it looks reliable, for reference only.
✓ 12这样货已经在要货单上（12 个）。 · Already on the request (12).

建议订货：遇到这些情况Suggested order: when this happens

同事已经加了这样货 · A colleague already added this item
「订」会显示同事填的数量。你不改它，就不会盖掉同事的；你改了，才用你的数字。
Order shows your colleague's quantity. If you don't change it, theirs stays; only if you change it is yours used.
找不到某样货 · An item is missing from the list
没卖过、寄卖品、或只用箱卖的货不在这里。照平常按「加货品」手动加。
Items with no sales, consignment items, and items sold only by the carton are not listed. Add them by hand with Add goods as usual.
新货、第一次卖 · A new item, never sold before
没有销量就算不出来，用「加货品」手动加，数量问店长。
No sales means no suggestion. Add it by hand with Add goods and ask the manager how many.
数到一半要走开 · I have to stop half-way
不关掉 App，同一个人同一天再打开，数过的货架还在。换人、隔天或 App 重开就要重新数，因为货架可能已经变了。数完一部分可以先按「加进要货单」，剩下的等一下再数。
Without closing the App, reopen it the same day and your counts are still there. A different person, the next day, or a restarted App starts fresh, because the shelf may have changed. You can tap Add to the request for what you have counted and do the rest later.
为什么要选原因？HQ 审批时会看到每一行的建议数、货架数和原因。HQ 会拿这些资料对比「建议 vs 实际卖出 vs 报废」，原因写得清楚，以后的建议就更准。
Why pick a reason? When HQ reviews the request it sees each line's suggestion, shelf count and reason. HQ uses this to compare suggested vs actually sold vs disposed; clear reasons make future suggestions better.
⑥ 咖啡馆 · Café BR24 / BR26

咖啡馆：在 24 Xpress 门店买的货Cafés: goods bought at a 24 Xpress store

咖啡馆在 24 Xpress 门店收银台买的货，回到咖啡馆都要在 App 收货，会计才能入咖啡馆的帐。
Goods the café buys at a 24 Xpress till must be received in the App back at the café, so accounting can book them to the café company.

  1. 收货 → 供应商选「24XPRESS SDN BHD」（4000-2001）。
    Goods receive → supplier 24XPRESS SDN BHD (4000-2001).
  2. 拍 POS 收据（整张入镜）。一张收据开一张收货单。
    Photograph the POS receipt (whole receipt in frame). One receiving per receipt.
  3. 填 POS 收据号，照收据上抄，例如 BR01-000123。
    Type the POS receipt no. exactly as printed, e.g. BR01-000123.
  4. AI 读单、逐行核对、数实际拿到几个，和其他供应商一样。少了、坏了照样填。
    Read with AI, check each line, count what you actually got, the same as any supplier. Record anything short or damaged.
  5. 送出。会计会按收据入咖啡馆的帐。
    Send. Accounting books it to the café from the receipt.
咖啡馆收货 · BR24

没有 POS 收据No POS receipt

货直接从门店拿，没有在收银台打单：勾选「没有 POS 收据」，再选货是从哪间门店拿的（必填，不选不能送出）。月底由会计开单给咖啡馆。
Goods taken from the store without a till sale: tick No POS receipt, then choose which store the goods came from (required; it cannot be sent without it). At month end accounting invoices the café.

同一张收据收了两次 · The same receipt entered twice
系统会认出同一个收据号（有没有空格都一样），第二张不会重复入帐，会计会看到提醒。
The system recognises the same receipt no. (with or without spaces); the second is not booked again, and accounting is alerted.
没有收据 · No receipt
